text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali hailed Deng Xiaoping as a great leader who guided China to a new era of prosperity.
-French Defence Minister Charles Millon expected on Sunday in Tunis for talks with Tunisian officials.
- Tunis Stock Exchange set for a rebound.
- Arab ministers of culture to meet in Tunis on February 26-28 for their annual gathering.
- Works worth 50 million dinars ($50 million) are going on to expand Tunis-Carthage airport facilities.
- Two Saudi teams visited Tunis this week to oversee recruitment of Tunisian engineers and doctors.
